authority: Stream Bandit TCG collectible printing and artwork identity ledger
rules_authority: Structured card definitions remain gameplay authority. Printing rarity, finish and artwork do not alter gameplay rules unless a future series defines a new card identity.

identity_chain.card_id: Canonical gameplay identity. Rules, stats, attacks and abilities bind here.
identity_chain.printing_id: Canonical collectible version of a card. Collection, pack, reward and cosmetic ownership bind here.
identity_chain.artwork_id: Canonical media identity for the current artwork revision of a printing. Asset lookup binds here.

id_contract.revision_rule: Corrected/replaced media may increment artwork revision without changing printing_id. A genuinely distinct collectible art/finish variant gets a distinct edition_code/printing_id.

compatibility.ledger_artwork_id_mapping: Until/if a dedicated database artwork_id field is introduced, artwork_id may be mirrored in printing metadata; this ledger remains repository authority for file identity.
